## 🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE

This is a major structural release. The project's internal architecture has been reorganized, startup performance has been massively improved, and a new companion tool has been added. This release is labeled as a major version because of the internal changes, not just the number of new features.

**A clean installation is highly recommended.** Because the internal file structure changed significantly in this release, updating on top of a previous version may leave files in the wrong location. A fresh install ensures everything works as intended. With the updated Installer, you can make a Clean Install.

---

## 🚀 Startup Improvements

The single biggest change in this release. MPV-SW-Capture now loads in a fraction of the time it used to.

- **Window visible in ~0.15s** (was ~3.0s on v5.1.0). A 20× improvement.
- **Faster startup checks.** What used to block the window for ~2.85 seconds now runs in the background and finishes in under 1 second.
- **Overlay render throttled.** The menu no longer rebuilds itself for every cursor movement. This reduces CPU usage when navigating quickly, with no visible difference.
- **Audio refresh cached** for the ffplay backend. Repeated refreshes reuse cached values instead of doing redundant work.

> The capture window now appears the moment you launch it.

---

## ✨ New Tool: Stream Menu

A new external companion tool for MPV-SW-Capture, designed for streamers who need to control the capture without ever showing the internal overlay on screen.

- **Fully external**: runs as its own window, independent from the overlay.
- **Complete controls**: window position (9 slots), Auto ICC, Fullscreen, On Top, Fit Full, Screenshot, Record, Clean All.
- **Shader, Shapes, Crops and Bezels dropdowns**, read live from `menu.conf`.
- **Recording panel** with countdown and progress bar.
- **Focus MPV button** that brings the capture window to the foreground, even if minimized or behind other windows.
- **Fill Screen toggle** aligned with the CROPS and BEZELS dropdowns.
- **Lock Menu + Hide OSD Messages** with visual states, mirroring the internal overlay.
- **Full language support** via the same language files used by the rest of the project.
- **Create Desktop Shortcut button** that generates a shortcut in Desktop for full and easy access.
- **Accessible from `TOOLS`**, from the folder, and from the desktop shortcut.

---

## ✨ New Feature: Install → Clean Install

An optional installation option that guarantees a fully fresh setup while keeping a safety backup of the previous version.

- **Clean Install checkbox** in the MPV-SW-Capture card — checked by default, and auto-disabled when no previous MPV-SW-Capture install is detected.
- **`OLDMSC` backup folder**: old files are moved here (fixed name, overwritten on each clean install to avoid accumulation).
- **Core binaries preserved**: `ffmpeg.exe`, `ffplay.exe` and `mpv.exe` always stay in the root.
- **Tools configs protected**: `tools\*.json` user files are backed up and restored across the swap.
- **Records and Screenshot preserved**: `_screenshots\` and `_record\` user files always stay in the root.
- **Manual closure**: after a clean install, a dialog shows the backup location and reminds the user to close and reopen the installer.
- **Safe fallback**: if the clean install fails, the installer logs the error and falls back to the normal in-place update.
- **Available everywhere**: works with single MPV-SW-Capture install, Install / Update ALL and Force Reinstall ALL.

> Ideal for anyone who just wants to update and keep everything working fine.

---

## 🎚️ WASAPI Period Mode

This new feature lets you tune the periodic engine of the WASAPI capture path, if you are experiencing crackling in the captured audio.

- **Options**: `minimum`, `fundamental`, `default`, `maximum`. The app starts with `minimum` by default.
- **What it does**: controls the balance between latency and stability of the WASAPI shared-mode capture stream.
- **When to change it**: if you experience crackling or clicks in the captured audio with your specific capture card, try a different option until you find one that works.
- **Configurable from the Setup GUI**, in the **WASAPI PERIOD MODE** section. No rebuild required.

---

## 🧷 Keep Menu Open (New Quick Option)

A new toggle in **Quick Options → SETTINGS** that disables the 3-second auto-hide cycle triggered when applying shaders, shapes, crops, or bezels.

- **What it does**: when ON, the overlay stays open after applying a menu item instead of hiding and reappearing 3 seconds later.
- **When to use it**: while tuning shaders, shapes, and crops in real time, so you can see the effect and keep browsing without the overlay disappearing.
- **Persistence**: the state is saved and survives restarts.
- **Default**: OFF (same as previous versions).

---

## 🛟 Orphan Recording Recovery

If a recording is interrupted abruptly (forced close, power loss, OS crash), the temporary `.mkv` and `.wav` files left behind are now recovered automatically on the next launch.

- **Automatic conversion**: on startup, MPV-SW-Capture tries to merge orphaned pairs into a valid `.mp4`.
- **Silent operation**: no OSD messages. The recovery runs transparently.
- **Cleanup on failure**: if the merge fails, the orphan files are deleted immediately.
- **Lone files**: a video without its audio (or vice versa) is deleted outright, since nothing can be recovered from it.
- **Consistent state**: `_record/` always ends up either empty or with a valid `.mp4`.

---

## 🎥 FFPlay Stream Helper (Renamed)

Renamed from "Stream Helper" to "FFPlay Stream Helper" in all labels, titles, and internal references.

- **Why**: this tool is exclusive to the ffplay backend. WASAPI is now the default and modern mode, and does not need this tool for OBS or other capture software.
- **Behavior**: unchanged. Only the name was updated.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes and Updates

### Overlay

- **TAB key bug**: pressing TAB to cycle through sections on the last section used to close the menu and prevent reopening without restarting the program. Fixed.
- **Double-click inside the menu**: double-click no longer triggers fullscreen while also activating the selected item. The double-click is intercepted while the overlay is open, and returns to normal once the menu is closed.
- **Double-fire on cards**: a double-click on an option used to run the action twice. A 1.2-second debounce now prevents duplicate triggers.
- **Menu icon spacing**: icons and text inside the cards were sitting too close to the left edge. They now have proper padding, giving the whole menu a cleaner, more polished look.

### First-time Install

- **`1_INSTALLER_MSC_First-Usage.cmd` auto-open Setup**: after completing the first-usage install flow, it required pressing a key to open the Setup. Now it **opens automatically**.

---

## 🔧 Internal Reorganization

This is the main reason for the major version bump. Any future development now assumes this new structure.

- **Internal folder reorganization.** Files that are not MPV scripts were moved out of `scripts/`, making the internal structure clearer for future development.
- **More robust file paths.** Internal scripts now resolve paths from the project root, so moving them around no longer breaks anything.

---

## 📌 Notes

- Detailed installation guides and more are available at the **[Official MPV-SW-Capture Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)**.
- **ESPAÑOL**: Revisa el **[Sitio Oficial de MPV-SW-Capture](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/?lang=es)** para la Guía de Instalación y otras guías útiles.

## 🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE

## This release introduces a key feature that will positively shape the future of the project, alongside a set of improvements to make the experience smoother and more polished.
**WASAPI Audio Plugin is now the default audio backend.** New installations will use it automatically. If your system does not support it, or you run into issues, you can switch to the legacy `FFplay Low Latency` mode from **AUDIO → AUDIO OUTPUT MODE**.

Additionally, a few user preferences now persist across sessions — you no longer need to reconfigure them every time you open MPV-SW-Capture.

---

## 🔊 New Feature: WASAPI Audio Plugin

A brand-new audio backend has been added and is now the **default mode**.

- **What it is**: a native audio plugin that replaces the old FFplay-based capture path.
- **Why it exists**: it delivers better quality with lower CPU and RAM usage compared to FFplay.
- **Native integration**: works out of the box with OBS, Discord, and other capture tools — no third-party plugins required.
- **Fallback available**: if your system does not support it, you can switch to `FFplay Low Latency` from **AUDIO → AUDIO OUTPUT MODE**.

> 🙏 Thanks to **z-er** for creating this plugin and its integration into the AUDIO menu.

---

## 🎚️ AUDIO → AUDIO OUTPUT MODE

A new section in the **AUDIO** menu that lets you choose between the two available backends:

- **WASAPI Audio Plugin** — the new default. Recommended for most users.
- **FFplay Low Latency** — the legacy backend. Use only if your system does not support WASAPI, or if you experience issues.

---

## 🎛️ New Feature: Hover Volume Sidebar

A new optional feature that adds a floating audio rail on the **left edge** of the window.

- **How it works**: move the cursor to the middle-left edge of the video and a mini sidebar appears.
- **What it controls**: Volume and Audio Boost, with a graphical slider.
- **No menu needed**: adjust audio on the fly without opening the full menu.
- **Toggle**: can be enabled or disabled from **AUDIO** at any time.

> 🙏 Thanks to **z-er** for creating this feature.

---

## 💾 Persistent Settings

The following options are now saved and restored automatically across sessions:

- **Audio Boost** — the percentage you selected.
- **Audio Output Mode** — your preferred backend.
- **Hover Volume Sidebar** — enabled or disabled.
- **Change to Auto ICC Profile** — enabled or disabled.

---

## 🔇 Mute Button in the Audio Bar

A new audio icon sits next to the volume percentage:

- **Click** to toggle mute. The icon changes accordingly.
- When muted, the volume label switches to **"MUTED"**.

---

## 🖥️ Header Improvements

The header has been redesigned and expanded:

- Previously only showed the capture device name and the current resolution. It now also displays the **active audio output** at a glance.
- All items are aligned with their own icons (resolution and audio).
- The green audio icon in the header is **clickable** and toggles mute/unmute, mirroring the button in the audio bar.

---

## 📋 Menu Improvements

### Section descriptions

Every menu section now shows a short explanatory text at the bottom, summarizing what that section does.

### Bezels section restructured

The Bezels section has been reorganized with tabs:

- **All** — shows all available bezels.
- **NSO** — reveals sub-tabs organized by console (NES, SNES, GB, GBA, N64, etc.).
- **PERSONAL** — appears automatically when you create non-NSO bezels from the Bezel Manager.

### New Quick Option

- **Change to Auto ICC Profile** added to **Quick Options → SETTINGS**.

### Custom icons

Most menu options now have their own custom icon instead of the generic LCD monitor placeholder, giving the interface a cleaner, more polished look.

---

## 🪟 Taskbar and System Integration

- MPV-SW-Capture icon now appears correctly in the **Windows taskbar** when running.
- When using the **WASAPI** audio backend, the application icon also appears in the **Windows volume mixer**.

> 🙏 Thanks to **z-er** for helping to fix this.

---

## 🛠️ Setup Improvements

Two new options have been added to the Setup tool:

- **AUTOSTART WITH THE FOLLOWING AUDIO OUTPUT** — choose between **WASAPI** or **FFPLAY** as the default backend.
- **AUTOSTART WITH HOVER VOLUME SIDEBAR** — choose whether the sidebar is active on launch.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes and Updates

- **Multiple scripts optimized** for better performance and stability.
- **Setup and all TOOLS fixed** to be fully compatible with this new version.
- **Installer fixed** with a function that, if TAR cannot uncompress .7z, automatically download portable 7zr to uncompress the files. This fixed issues if TAR fails, making possible to uncompress always.

---

## 📌 Notes

- Detailed installation guides and more are available at the **[Official MPV-SW-Capture Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)**.
- **ESPAÑOL**: Revisa el **[Sitio Oficial de MPV-SW-Capture](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/?lang=es)** para la Guía de Instalación y otras guías útiles.

## 🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE (v5.0.0)

As part of ongoing improvements, several core components have been reworked — the menu, the launchers, the installer, and the localization system. This release brings a new graphical interface, a new audio feature, and numerous internal fixes.

All launchers have been fully migrated to `.vbs` and `.cmd` scripts for better portability and security. These scripts work exactly like the original executables, but are lighter, avoid false positives, and no longer contain system metadata.

**TOOLS are not included in the main package.** They are available in two ways: as a separate ZIP file named `TOOLS_*.zip`, or directly through the Installer (which can download and install them for you). This keeps the core version cleaner and lets you install only what you need.

> ⚠️ **First-time installation:** run **`1_INSTALLER_MSC_First-Usage.cmd`** before anything else.

---

## 🚀 Program Launcher Overhaul

The way you open MPV-SW-Capture components has been completely redefined:

- **Unified VBS launchers**: All tools (Setup, Installer, Video Manager, Bezel Manager, Stream Helper) are now opened via `.vbs` scripts. These are portable, lightweight, and do not trigger antivirus warnings.
- **First-time installation**: New users must run `1_INSTALLER_MSC_First-Usage.cmd`, which displays clear instructions before launching the installer.
- **Post-installation workflow**: Once `ffmpeg.exe`, `ffplay.exe`, `mpv.exe`, and MPV-SW-Capture are installed, you can use `MPV-SW-Capture_INSTALLER.vbs` for future updates.
- **Seamless integration**: After initial setup, all tools can be accessed directly from the MPV menu (`TOOLS` section), providing a superior experience without security warnings.

---

## 🎨 New Graphical Menu (ASS)

The classic list-based options menu has been **completely replaced** with a modern graphical interface, styled like a Smart-TV menu.

- **Built on ASS** (Advanced SubStation Alpha): the menu is now drawn as a rich overlay, fully interactive and easy to navigate.
- **Modern and functional**: faster to use than the old nested menu, with a cleaner layout and better visual feedback.
- **Restructured sections**: the old `OTHERS` section was split into two independent sidebar entries — **HELP** and **TOOLS** — for faster access.
- **New capabilities compared to the old menu:**
  - Section-based navigation with visual sidebar and badges.
  - Dedicated cards per option, with active-state indicators.
  - Draggable audio sliders (Volume and Audio Boost) with a live effective-gain readout.
  - Tabbed sections for groups (Shaders, Shapes, Crops, Bezels, Window, Video Options, Audio).
  - **In-menu language switcher**: change the interface language on the fly by clicking the **language button** — either the one in **Quick Options → SETTINGS** or the one in the **header** (`EN`, `ES`, `JP`). Each click cycles to the next available language.
  - Keyboard and mouse support with hover highlighting.
  - Quick Actions section for fast access to common tasks.
  - **Independent cursor and active-state indicators**: the accent border marks where the **cursor** is, while the **✓ checkmark** marks which option is **active**. They move independently — the border follows you, the checkmark stays on the active card.
  - **Header quick actions**: 4 clickable buttons — `TAKE SCREENSHOT`, `RECORD VIDEO`, the **language badge** (`EN`/`ES`/`JP`), and the **close button** (`X`). Screenshot and Record close the menu after running, mirroring the `CAPTURE` section.
  - **Auto-close sections**: Shaders, Shapes, Crops, and Bezels hide the menu after applying a card and **reopen it 3 seconds later**. Audio Boost options behave the same so the slider reflects the new value.
  - **Expanded `CLEAN ALL`**: now performs a full reset — clears shaders, shapes, crops, and bezels, and additionally restores window size (1.0x), position (centered), rotation (0°), border, title bar, Always On Top, aspect override (16:9), and Deband (off).
  - **Configurable sections and languages**: `scripts/sections.dat` and `scripts/lang/language_list.dat` now allow you to extend or restrict which sections and languages appear in the menu — no code changes needed.

> **Sections at a glance:** ⚡ Quick Options · 🎬 SHADERS · ⬒ SHAPES · ✂ CROPS · 🖼 BEZELS · 🪟 WINDOW · 📸 CAPTURE · 🎞 VIDEO OPTIONS · 🔊 AUDIO · 😭 HELP · 🧰 TOOLS

> 🙏 Thanks to **supremeuefn** for the initial alpha version of this GUI menu.

> 📖 **Want a detailed walkthrough of every option?**
> See the full [MSC Menu Guide](https://github.com/TyRaS-SW/MPV-SW-Capture/wiki/Guide%E2%80%90MSC-Menu).

---

## 🔊 New Feature: Audio Boost

A brand-new audio option has been added to the menu: **Audio Boost**.

- **What it does**: amplifies the capture card's audio **beyond the standard 100%**.
- **Range**: from 100% (no boost) up to **400% (×4)**.
- **Why it exists**: ideal for users whose captured content has a very low volume and needs to be raised beyond normal limits.
- **Where to find it**: available in the **Quick Options** and **AUDIO** sections, alongside the standard Volume slider.
- **Effective gain indicator**: shows the combined Volume × Boost result, with a colour-coded warning when clipping risk is high.
- **Audio Boost remembers your setting**: There's no need to reconfigure it every time. Pick a value, close the program, and it will be exactly where you left it when you come back.

> 🙏 Thanks to **supremeuefn** for collaborating on this feature.

---

## 🛠️ Installer Improvements

The installer has been significantly upgraded to be more robust and user-friendly:

- **Extra Tools support**: You can now install additional tools directly from the installer. Check the box `"Install Extra Tools with Install / Update All?"` and click `"Install / Update ALL"` to download and install everything, including the extras.
- **Smart file detection**: If you accidentally delete `mpv.exe`, `ffplay.exe`, or `ffmpeg.exe`, the installer's **Check** function will detect their absence and allow you to re-download them easily.
- **Under-the-hood optimizations**: Several internal improvements have been made to enhance stability and performance.

---

## 🖼️ New Bezel Feature: "Fit Full 16:9 to Bezel"

A powerful new option has been added to the Bezel system:

- **Function**: It allows you to fit the entire 16:9 content window perfectly inside a chosen bezel frame.
- **How to use**: Select a bezel frame first, then navigate to `BEZELS > Fit Full 16:9 to Bezel`.
- This feature lets you enjoy your 16:9 content in your favorite bezels without cutting the image.

---

## 🌐 Translation & Localization Improvements

The translation system has been enhanced for better accuracy and future expandability:

- **Improved Spanish translations**: The Spanish version now includes proper accents and more natural phrasing, fixing previous issues.
- **New language: Japanese** — `日本語` is now selectable from the interface language list.
- **Setup language selector**: The Setup tool now presents a **list of available languages** that you can pick from. Just select your language and press **"Apply Language"**.
- **In-menu language switching**: You can also swap languages without leaving MPV — use the language button in **Quick Options → SETTINGS** or the header button (`EN`, `ES`, `JP`). Each click cycles to the next available language.
- **Configurable language list**: available languages are read from `scripts/lang/language_list.dat`, making it easy to add new ones.
- **Better translation engine**: The way translations are handled has been refined, making the interface more consistent and easier to maintain.
- **Future-ready**: The new system opens the door for adding additional languages in future releases.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes and Updates

- **Setup device scan fixed**: On certain PCs with many capture devices, the Setup tool failed to scan them correctly. This has been fixed.
- **Launchers migrated to VBS**: The old `.exe` and most `.cmd` launchers were replaced with `.vbs` scripts. Only `1_INSTALLER_MSC_First-Usage.cmd` remains as a CMD for the initial install.
-  **Audio control** — fixed.
- **Documentation updated**:
  - **Installation Guide** — refreshed to match the new launcher flow.
  - **MSC Menu Guide** — new guide covering every menu option in detail.

> 🙏 Thanks to **z-er** for reporting and fixing the Setup device scan issue.

---

## 📌 Notes

- `mpv` and `ffmpeg`/`ffplay` are not included in this release. You can download them using the installer or from their official sources.
- The **TOOLS** package (`TOOLS_*.zip`) is now separate. Download it from the **Assets** section below if you need the extra utilities.
- For detailed installation guides and more, visit the **[Official MPV-SW-Capture Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)**.
- **ESPAÑOL**: Revisa el **[Sitio Oficial de MPV-SW-Capture](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/?lang=es)** para la Guía de Instalación y otras guías útiles.

## 🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE (v4.2.0 release)

As part of the ongoing improvement, all `.exe` launchers remain replaced with `.cmd` scripts. These scripts work exactly like the original executables.

**TOOLS aren't in the main version. You can download it in the separated zip called `TOOLS_*.zip`**
---

## 🎵 Audio System Overhaul

- The audio control system has been completely redesigned and optimized for smoother and better experience.
- Now uses a more efficient and stable method to control `ffplay` volume.
- Improved responsiveness and reliability when adjusting volume from MPV menus or keyboard shortcuts.

## 🛠️ Installer Improvements

- The installer no longer requires an external 7‑Zip executable.
- It now uses the **native `tar` command** included in Windows 10/11 to extract `.7z` archives.
- This eliminates the need to download and run `7zr.exe`, reducing the risk of false positives and making the installation process faster and more secure.

## ⚙️ Other Internal Improvements

- Several internal optimizations have been applied to improve overall performance and stability.
- Code cleanup and refactoring to make future maintenance easier.


## 📌 Notes

- `mpv` and `ffmpeg`/`ffplay` are not included. Download them from their official sources or use the installer.
- Check **[Official MPV-SW-Capture Website](https://tyras-sw.github.io/MPV-SW-Capture/)** for Installation Guide and more useful guides.

## 🔔 IMPORTANT NOTICE (v4.1.1 emergency release)

Due to some problems with `exe` files have been replaced with `.vbs` scripts as an emergency workaround. Also, all tools are now `.vbs` too.

- Please use `Installer_MPV-SW-Capture.vbs` to run the Installer.
- Please use `Setup_MPV-SW-Capture.vbs` to run the Setup.
- Please use `MSC_Bezel_Manager.vbs`, `MSC_Stream_Helper.vbs` and `MSC_Video_Manager.vbs` to run any of these tools. 
- These scripts work exactly like the original executables.

We are actively working on a permanent solution and expect to restore the executables in a future release.

---

## ✨ New: Tools Menu in MPV-SW-Capture

- A new **TOOLS** submenu has been added under **OTHERS** in the mpv menu.
- This allows you to open the available tools (Bezel Manager, Video Manager, Stream Helper) directly from the mpv interface.
- Also, in the same submenu, you can find **INSTALLERS**, where you can also open the Installer and Setup directly here.
- Provides an alternative way to access the tools without manually launching the `.exe` or `.vbs` files.

## ⏱️ Improved: Version Check Message Duration

- The OSD message when checking for updates (`HELP -> Check Latest MSC Version`) now stays visible for **4 seconds** (increased from 1 second).
- This gives you more time to read the version status and take action if needed.

## 🛠️ Fixed Tool: `MSC_Stream_Helper.exe`

- This tool is now renamed from `MSC_Stream_Manager` to `MSC_Stream_Helper`.
- It also has a fixed functionality. Now, you need to manually search for OBS if it's installed (similar to portable mode).
- Some extra fixes have been applied.

## 🧹 Minor Menu Fixes

- Several minor adjustments and improvements have been made to the menu for a smoother experience.

- `mpv` and `ffmpeg`/`ffplay` are not included. Download them from their official sources or use the installer.
